controls.description: Vertiv Liebert iCOM microprocessor control. Events are text messages; each has an internal delay (factory, fixed), a default delay (often adjustable) and a type: Message (log only), Warning (yellow dot, LED flashes) or Alarm (red dot, LED flashes, audible). Disabled events are not logged. Safety functions (high/low pressure, main fan overload) act regardless of the event type. Default passwords: User 1490, Service 5010. Touchscreen iCOM keeps the last 400 events.

faultCodes.meaning: LOSS OF AIRFLOW / Loss of Air Flow: airflow loss sensed by the differential air pressure switch; compressor, heat and humidifier are switched off. Internal delay 3 s, default delay 3 s (0-9999), default type Alarm (adjustable).
likelyCauses: Blocked unit air inlet or outlet / dirty filters
Blower motor fuses or overload tripped
Broken belt or blower wheel loose on the shaft
Fan contactor or EC fan fault
Differential air pressure switch tubing or setting
checks: Check for blockage of the unit air outlet or inlet
Check blower motor fuses and overload reset
Check for broken belts; make sure blower wheels are tight to the shaft
Run diagnostics to see if the fan contactor works
Alarm action setting: Shutdown (DX units) vs Disable (chilled water: stops humidifier/heaters/dehumidification, allows cooling)

faultCodes.meaning: High head (discharge) pressure on compressor circuit 1; the compressor is locked off. In the first 10 min of run the control retries several times silently, then alarms and locks the compressor off; 3 HP trips in a rolling 12 h lock it off; after 10 min of run any HP trip alarms and locks off immediately. With manual-reset HP switches the alarm comes 30 s after the event.
likelyCauses: Air-cooled: no power to the condenser, condenser fans not running, failed head-pressure control (fan speed control / Lee-Temp valve), dirty condenser coil, closed service valve, crimped line
Water/glycol: water-regulating valve, low flow (pumps off, valves closed), drycooler/tower not running, entering fluid above design
checks: Head pressure vs. condenser entering conditions
Condenser power, fans and the contactor side switch that enables the condenser control circuit
Water/glycol flow, regulating valve and fluid temperature
After fixing the cause: cycle main power, or set the High Pressure Alarm Code to 0 (Service > Diagnostics > Compressor Circuit N > Set to Zero > Save); code 0 = OK, non-zero = high head pressure

faultCodes.meaning: Circuit 1 high discharge pressure (App. B S251/S252; DSE Table 4.5).
likelyCauses: Air-cooled: no power to the condenser, condenser fans not running, failed head-pressure control (fan speed control / Lee-Temp valve), dirty condenser coil, closed service valve, crimped line
Water/glycol: water-regulating valve, low flow (pumps off, valves closed), drycooler/tower not running, entering fluid above design
checks: Head pressure vs. condenser entering conditions
Condenser power, fans and the contactor side switch that enables the condenser control circuit

diagnosticTips: Passwords: User 1490, Service 5010 (small/large display and touchscreen iCOM). Settings are readable without a password.
Acknowledge on the touchscreen: ALARMS panel > Acknowledge All; events that need a manual reset show Reset All.

High-pressure lockout: fix the cause, then set the High Pressure Alarm Code to 0 (Service > Diagnostics > Compressor Circuit N > Set to Zero > Save) or cycle main power. Low Pressure Alarm Code works the same way.
Digital scroll high temperature: 5 events in a rolling 4 h lock the compressor out; reset the HT counter to 0 and press alarm reset.
Pump down: 3 failed tries lock the compressor and LLSV off; more than 6 re-pump-downs per hour gives PUMPDOWN FAIL. Reset with the Pump Down Failure Counter in Diagnostics.

Charge mode: Service > Diagnostics > Manual Mode (times out after 30 min) > fans on > Compressor Mode = Charge (full capacity, LLSV energized, reheat/humidifier off). Keep >= 20 psig suction for the compressor to run.
Digital scroll: the solenoid cycles in 15-s periods (energized = unloaded). Below 100 % capacity the sight glass may show bubbles every cycle; it is not a charge indicator.
Short cycle: run time must exceed 3 min; set the temperature deadband to 2 and increase the proportional band / integration time.
Event types and delays are configurable per unit; the unit's Alarm/Event Setup screen is authoritative where manuals disagree (e.g. LOSS OF POWER ALM vs WARNING).
HP cut-out by product: 360 psig (DS/3 R-22, Challenger R-407C), 400 psig (Liebert DS R-407C, Mini-Mate2), 580 psig (PDX R-410A).

commonIssues.symptom: Liebert water/glycol-cooled unit: condenser water keeps flowing after the compressors stop
likelyCauses: Valve capillary not connected to the condenser
checks: 10-15 min after the compressors stop flow should stop; if not, reset the valve or reconnect the capillary
sources: Liebert DS Installer/User Guide SL-18826 Rev 4

commonIssues.symptom: Liebert compressor cycles continually or trips on its motor protector
likelyCauses: Bad LP switch, dirty/restricted pressure-stat tubing, defective LLSV, plugged filter-drier (cycling)
High discharge pressure, defective overload, high suction temperature, loose wiring, low line voltage (motor protector)
Seized compressor, shorted/grounded winding, single phasing (locked rotor)
checks: Check LP switch and tubing, LLSV and filter-drier
Check head pressure, superheat (adjust TXV), wiring and voltage
Check all 3 legs at the contactor
sources: Liebert Deluxe System/3 Operation & Maintenance SL-18345 Rev 02 (08-06) Table 23

commonIssues.symptom: Liebert EC evaporator fan stopped or fan failure event
checks: Check fuses; if OK check connections (on the strand, not the insulation), cycle mains, check phase-to-ground voltage at KL1
If fuses are blown, measure L1-L2, L2-L3, L1-L3 resistance at KL1 with power wires removed
Caution: a faulted motor can restart by itself when the fault clears
sources: Liebert DS Installer/User Guide SL-18826 Rev 4 Table 9.2
Liebert PDX and PCW Installer/User Guide SL-19800 Rev 14 (05-26) Table 9.2

checks: Adjust no more than 1 turn at a time and allow up to 30 min (clockwise raises superheat)
Oil level 1/2-3/4 of the sight glass after >= 5 min run
sources: Liebert Deluxe System/3 Operation & Maintenance SL-18345 Rev 02 (08-06) §7.4.1, §7.4.5

notes: Created 2026-10-20 by moving the Liebert entries (model format liebert-crac, control platform liebert-icom, two common issues and the electrical entry) out of others.json and extending them from 27 downloaded Liebert/Vertiv manuals.

Corrections to the earlier others.json data: DS = Liebert DS downflow and VS = Liebert DS upflow (VS was missing); DE = Deluxe System/3 downflow DX with Econ-O-Coil (not chilled water; chilled-water DS/3 sizes end in C); the DS/3 size code is kBtu/h; PX = PDX and PW = PCW confirmed, 'PH' dropped (no source); refrigerant is per line, not R-407C for the whole family: DS/3 R-22, Challenger iCOM / Liebert DS / Mini-Mate2 R-407C, PDX / CRV DX / XDP R-410A (XDP also R-134a).

Conflicts inside Vertiv documents (SL-31075 Table 4.2 vs Appendix B default types for EL HEAT HIGH TEMP, LOSS OF POWER, COMP SHORT CYCLE, CALL SERVICE, HIGH TEMPERATURE) are kept in the event notes; the unit's own Alarm/Event Setup screen is authoritative.

Not covered: Liebert HPC/HPM, SmartAisle, CoolPhase, XDU hardware, AFC chillers, Liebert DM/CW, Datamate, XDP/XDC/XDV/XDO alarm lists, SM (Standard Microprocessor) LED list, SiteScan/IntelliSlot point maps; serial decoding has only one secondary source.
